<div class="home-panel-content">

Each module combines text-based teaching, diagrams, and knowledge checks to support active learning. Many modules also use case-based learning, guiding you through realistic patient scenarios and asking you to apply concepts as you go.

The goal is to connect foundational knowledge with clinical decision-making: recognizing important pain patterns, identifying red flags, interpreting investigations in context, and considering appropriate management options.

Throughout the modules, you will also encounter **Callouts**, each highlighting a different type of learning point. Examples and descriptions of their roles are shown below.
